purpose: CQ12 slice 5: published references a CIO can set the assessment against. Each is a published figure with source, year and sample, shown as context and never as an LTM peer benchmark. The band edges are the size classes of CORE-03 and CORE-04 in US dollars; both questions use the same conversion, so their ratio does not depend on the reporting currency.

spendToRevenue.status: On by owner decision (10 Nov 2026): Deloitte may be named as the publisher of a dated source citation (banned-phrases.json narrowed accordingly). Flexera's Tech Spend Pulse gives its figure only in charts, so it could not be verified and is not used.
spendToRevenue.measure: technology investment as a share of revenue, average across respondents
spendToRevenue.sample: 662 senior technology leaders in the Americas, EMEA and Asia-Pacific
spendToRevenue.caveat: A cross-industry average, not a benchmark of the client's peers: industries differ widely, no verified industry split is published, and the study's definition of technology investment may differ from the spend put in scope here.
